flows.description: Susceptible humans become exposed to the Zika virus through bites from infectious mosquitoes.
Exposed humans progress to the infectious stage after the incubation period.
Infectious humans recover from the Zika virus infection.
Mosquito eggs develop and hatch into the larval stage.
Mosquito larvae mature and transition into the pupal stage.
Mosquito pupae emerge as susceptible adult female mosquitoes.
Susceptible female mosquitoes become exposed to the Zika virus by biting infectious humans.
Exposed female mosquitoes become infectious after the virus incubation period.
